summary: Banco Santander (Brasil) filed a Form 6-K with a notice to shareholders regarding the declaration and payment of Interest on Equity (IOE). The Board of Directors approved a gross distribution of R$ 2 billion (R$1.65 billion net after withholding tax), ad referendum of the next Ordinary General Meeting. Per-share amounts are specified for common, preferred shares, and units. The record date is July 21, 2026, with ex-IOE trading from July 22, 2026, and payment on August 6, 2026. This is a routine dividend-like distribution, not a special situation involving a change of control, restructuring, or corporate event.
